en.t: I was just about to ask: is this the first mating?

units.source_text: 对未婚女人做双手触诊时，必定要求其母亲或者亲属陪同。

en.t: When performing a bimanual examination on an unmarried woman, one must always require her mother or a relative to be present.

units.source_text: 我每每把在父亲的医院里看见的小姐们的陪同人，看成世间无比丑陋的人。

en.t: I always regarded the attendants of the young ladies I saw at my father's hospital as the ugliest people in the world.

units.source_text: 本是为了防范我父亲、呵护小姐们的纯洁而来的人，

en.t: They were people who had come to guard against my father and protect the young ladies' purity,

units.source_text: 反而令人感到他们的到来竟玷污了小姐们的纯洁似的。

en.t: yet instead their very arrival made it seem as if they had defiled that purity.

units.source_text: 我是那么深深地爱着父亲吗？

en.t: Did I love my father so deeply?

units.source_text: 哎哟，这不可能。

en.t: Oh no, that could not be.

units.source_text: 在小姐们看来，我是个女孩子。

en.t: In the young ladies' eyes, I was a little girl.

units.source_text: 小姐们把我抱起，让我坐在她们的膝盖上。

en.t: The young ladies picked me up and let me sit on their laps.

units.source_text: 我脸上飞起一片红潮。

en.t: A blush suddenly rose across my face.

units.source_text: 陌生的姐姐，你身上有我父亲的气味。

en.t: Strange older sister, you carry my father's scent.

units.source_text: 好几位小姐和她们的母亲。

en.t: Several young ladies and their mothers.

units.source_text: 我觉得自己似乎懂得年龄的丑陋。

en.t: I felt as though I understood the ugliness of age.

units.source_text: 哈夫洛克·埃利斯说过，三岁以后，人向野兽靠近。）
